prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Personality & Style Choice Grid: Redesign pet selection into a interactive split cards view with explicit style tags to prevent unexpected pet generation outputs. (why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with long wait times, and 3 support emails reported custom pets looking wrong or failing.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Quick-Reference Screen: Insert a new screen before completion showing key shortcuts and tray icon controls for interacting with, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding completes.)
2: [home, hint] Desktop Display Health Verification Hint: Display an active render status hint and graphics driver check on the waiting screen so users know their screen settings are compatible. (why: 3 support emails mentioned the pet failing to show up on the desktop or the app stalling at home load.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Framing & Quality Validation Flow: Add an explicit photo validation sub-flow screen that confirms image clarity and face detection prior to generation. (why: Custom pet generation fails or yields bad visual results for several users during adoption.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Time Expectation Copy: Update the header and hint copy on choose_path to explain what each adoption path entails and how fast setup takes. (why: The choose_path step has a median time of 8s but a mean time of 514s, indicating significant user idling and hesitation.)
5: [finish, redesign] System Tray & Desktop Pet Welcome Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a full-bleed spotlight screen emphasizing how the pet lives on the desktop toolbar. (why: Users finish onboarding (84.8% home -> 64.8% finish drop) and email support asking how to access their pet on desktop.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Status Safeguard & Offline Fallback: Add a connection status check and retry notification on the sign_in screen. (why: 2 support emails reported the sign-in screen stalling or failing to load properly.)

scores.note: Adoption step has high dropoff (39.1%) and support emails; UI redesign targets styling expectations.
Finish step drops significantly (35.2%) with user confusion, but adding a new screen requires release cost 0.
Home step retains 84.8% of users, though status hint addresses 3 support tickets about rendering.
Targets adoption dropoff with validation flow, though introducing a new flow screen carries higher build cost.
Copy change is config-only (cost 2) targeting high mean time on choose_path, though evidence relies mostly on time disparity.
Redesigns finishing experience to reduce 35.2% dropoff at finish backed by support emails.
Addresses sign_in edge cases mentioned in 2 support emails with moderate conversion impact.
